office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor cases for the City of Seattle for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: supervising public defender Katharine Edwards is the only candidate; no sitting judge is on the ballot for this seat.

candidates.summary: Supervising public defender with 16 years of practice in Seattle Municipal Court and other King County courts; not a sitting judge.
highlights: Supervising Public Defender; 16 years representing people charged with misdemeanors and felonies [S1]
Says she wants to see research and data on a program's effectiveness before ordering anyone into it [S1]
Endorsed by Seattle Municipal Court Judges Crawford-Willis, Shadid, and Vaddadi, among others [S1]
